categories.name: Sofas
categories.description: Deep seats, generous proportions and fabrics that age beautifully.

categories.name: Seating
categories.description: Lounge chairs, dining chairs and ottomans — each one modelled to the millimetre.

categories.name: Tables
categories.description: Coffee, side and pedestal tables in marble, oak and concrete.

categories.name: Storage
categories.description: Sideboards, chests and shelving built from solid timber.

products.name: Orbit Lounge Chair
products.short_description: A swivelling mid-century lounger with a moulded walnut shell and deeply quilted, aged leather. Built for long afternoons.
products.description:
The Orbit takes its cues from the great 1960s lounge chairs: a single moulded shell, a cushion that feels poured into place and a four-star base that turns a full 360°.

The quilted leather is vegetable-tanned and lightly waxed, so it darkens and softens with every year of use. A concealed tilt mechanism lets the seat lean back a few degrees when you do.
products.materials: Aged top-grain leather, moulded walnut veneer shell, polished aluminium swivel base

products.name: Luna Curved Sofa
products.short_description: A sweeping, kidney-shaped sofa in plush velvet that turns any corner into a conversation pit.
products.description:
Luna's open curve invites people in from every side. The seat is cut deep enough to tuck your feet under, while the low back keeps sightlines open in the middle of a room.

Choose from five performance velvets — each one stain-resistant, pet-friendly and swappable in the viewer above.
products.materials: Performance cotton velvet, high-resilience foam, solid beech frame, brass-capped steel legs

products.name: Fjord Lounge Armchair
products.short_description: Scandinavian lines, a solid-oak frame and plump leather cushions that sit back at just the right angle.
products.description:
Fjord is a study in restraint: a frame of solid, oiled oak with softly radiused arms, and two loose leather cushions strapped to it.

Pick the frame finish in the viewer — the leather stays the same rich black.
products.materials: Solid oak frame, saddle-leather seat and back cushions

products.name: Halo Marble Coffee Table
products.short_description: A floating disc of honed Carrara marble on a single ribbon of bent steel.
products.description:
Halo's base is formed from one continuous strip of steel, bent into interlocking loops so the marble seems to hover above the floor.

Every top is cut from a different slab — the veining on yours will be one of a kind.
products.materials: Honed Carrara marble top, bent blackened-steel base

products.name: Reed Sideboard
products.short_description: A long, low media sideboard with hand-reeded doors that catch the light.
products.description:
At almost two and a half metres, Reed is made for long walls and big record collections. Four push-to-open doors hide adjustable shelves and cable ports.

The reeded fronts are milled from solid walnut and finished with a matt hard-wax oil.
products.materials: Walnut veneer, solid walnut reeded doors, powder-coated steel hairpin legs

products.name: Sora Velvet Chair
products.short_description: A low, wide-seated accent chair with a channel-tufted back and a velvet that glows as you walk past.
products.description:
Sora sits a little lower and a little wider than a dining chair, which makes it the perfect reading perch or bedroom chair.

The velvet's sheen is rendered physically in the viewer — rotate it toward the light to see it shift.
products.materials: Mystere performance velvet, kiln-dried hardwood legs

products.name: Aldridge Heritage Sofa
products.short_description: A grand three-seater with rolled arms, a carved frame and a pile of mix-and-match jacquard cushions.
products.description:
Aldridge is our nod to the English country house: rolled arms, a hand-carved show-wood frame and loose cushions in paisley and stripe.

Eight-way hand-tied springs mean it will still feel this good in thirty years.
products.materials: Hand-carved hardwood frame, aniline leather, jacquard cushions

products.name: Noir Tufted Loveseat
products.short_description: A compact Chesterfield-style loveseat with deep buttoning and a gently scalloped base.
products.description:
Noir packs Chesterfield attitude into a two-seater that fits a study, a bay window or the end of a bed.

Each button is hand-tied, and the leather is finished to resist scuffs and spills.
products.materials: Deep-buttoned black leather, mahogany-stained hardwood base

products.name: Wren Dining Chair
products.short_description: A tall, diamond-tufted dining chair that makes every dinner feel like an occasion.
products.description: Wren's high back and diamond tufting bring a little ceremony to the table. It wipes clean in seconds and stacks neatly against the wall.
products.materials: Diamond-tufted faux leather, solid birch legs

products.name: Bram Leather Ottoman
products.short_description: A pillowy leather ottoman — footrest, extra seat or coffee table with a tray on top.
products.description: Bram's distressed leather looks like it has already lived a good life, and only gets better from here.

products.name: Versailles Bergère Chair
products.short_description: A classic French bergère with a hand-carved, ebonised frame and a soft linen seat.
products.description: Carved by hand in a family workshop, Versailles balances ornament and comfort: a deep seat, closed arms and a barrel back that wraps around you.
products.materials: Hand-carved beech frame in ebonised finish, linen-blend upholstery

products.name: Kite Coffee Table
products.short_description: A low concrete-and-oak table with a geometric inlay that wraps over the edges.
products.description: Kite pairs a cool, polished concrete top with warm oak chevrons that fold down into the legs. Sealed against rings and spills.
products.materials: Polished concrete top, solid oak inlay and frame

products.name: Cube Oak Side Table
products.short_description: A two-tier side table in solid oak, with room for a lamp up top and books below.
products.description: Simple, sturdy and endlessly useful. Cube is joined with traditional mortise-and-tenon joints — no visible screws.

products.name: Stem Pedestal Table
products.short_description: A slender pedestal table with flared legs and a lower shelf — perfect beside a reading chair.
products.description: Stem's splayed legs give it a surprisingly steady stance for such a small footprint.

products.name: Archive Chest of Drawers
products.short_description: A six-drawer chest inspired by old library card catalogues, complete with brass label pulls.
products.description: Archive is built from reclaimed pine, so every knot and nail hole has a story. The drawers run on solid wood runners, waxed for a smooth glide.

products.name: Grid Shelving Unit
products.short_description: A nine-cube shelving unit in solid pine — room divider, bookcase and display in one.
products.description: Use Grid against a wall or float it in the middle of a room: it is finished on both sides. Linen boxes slide into the bottom row.
